Body.Content:
Starting on December 11, 2026, the Use Copilot to create and edit Power Fx formulas and Power Apps Ideas formula assistance features in Power Apps will be no longer available.

How does this affect me?
The affected features will no longer be available to makers who use them to generate or transform Power Fx formulas after December 11, 2026. This will not impact existing formulas in published apps.

What action do I need to take?
There is no action required by makers. Tenant administrators should inform makers about this retirement.

message.Title: Power Apps - Formula assistance features in canvas apps are being retired
